name: Knight
description: A Knight is a warrior sworn to uphold the values of courage, honor, and loyalty. They are heavily armored, skilled in combat, and often serve as protectors of the realm, engaging in battles and quests to defend their people and lands.

actions.name: Long Sword
actions.description: The Knight makes a slashing attack with their long sword, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.description: After using the Long Sword action, the Knight follows up by slamming the same target with their shield, making an attack against the original defense check. This damage is added onto that of the Long Sword action before mitigations are applied.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving the Knight's area of control, they make an attack with their Long Sword action.

actions.name: Blade of the Dauntless
actions.description: The Knight makes an attack with their long sword using both hands with a 1d4 penalty. If the attack hits, allies within 4 units of the Knight gain a 1d4 bonus to their next resilience check until the start of the Knight's turn.

actions.name: Riposte
actions.description: In response to a melee attack being made against them, the Knight gains a 1d4 bonus to their block check. If the attack check is botched, the Knight makes an attack with their Long Sword action.

traits.name: Honorable Stand
traits.description: The knight can act normally until 3 lifeline points, at which they fall unconscious.
